scope: Read-only sampled call-path/interface audit of A06 frozen production sources and actual Go2 x Push evidence; no product changes, test additions, simulation or broad repository scan.

checks.name: composition_resolves_task_and_robot_before_shared_session
checks.call_path: prepare_from_args -> resolve_task_composition(provider) -> PushRecoveryCompositionProvider.resolve -> resolve_push_cell_manifest + PushRecoveryTaskPlugin + PushTaskMemoryAdapter + backend + Runner -> prepare_generation_foundation
checks.finding: Provider owns selected row/config and robot/task binding. Shared launch consumes ResolvedTaskComposition and frozen manifest; no Push-specific branch is required to run the lane/session.

checks.name: shared_host_runs_fixed_topology_task_adapter_supplies_semantics
checks.finding: Shared host owns two lanes, phase order, selected-only confirmation, generic score protocol/early rejection, receipts, atomic ledger closure and cost. Success/motion/force-sequence evidence and ranking are interpreted in PushPhasedEvaluationAdapter. PhasedEvaluationAdapter Protocol exchanges generic screens/results/selections, not Push field arguments.

checks.name: task_owned_qualification_and_final_comparison
checks.call_path: shared Genesis -> task_plugin.qualify_reference_result; shared final executor -> task_plugin.prepare_final_confirmation/summarize_final_comparison
checks.finding: Reference readiness, frozen cohort choice and final metric summary stay task-owned. Candidate acceptance uses the frozen task AcceptanceProtocol; no new sealed-drop or success-rate gate was inferred by this audit.

checks.name: reference_training_reuse_is_identity_recovery_not_task_logic
checks.call_path: prepare_generation_genesis -> prepare_session_genesis -> _load_completed_reference_training -> runner.recover_completed_train(original TrainJobSpec) -> new task materialized eval plan -> three new reference phases -> task qualification
checks.finding: Reuse checks generic task/backend/reference/scientific identity, validates original completion/checkpoint and retains original spec/result. Equality of task_id is identity checking, not task semantic dispatch. Only execution-placement fields job_id/device/GPU binding differ when comparing new requested train spec; source eval is not imported. No Push/Go2 cases in the reuse path.

checks.name: provider_service_stop_is_task_neutral
checks.call_path: ProviderCandidateError.requires_service_recovery -> complete_attempt(continue) -> ProviderServiceUnavailableError -> existing session exception cost/exit publication -> reraise
checks.finding: Classification depends on nonretryable HTTP401/402/403 only. No candidate defect is invented and no generation closure is manufactured. Existing unknown-usage budget guard remains intact; no robot/task-dependent recovery policy added.

checks.name: robot_facts_and_task_projection_have_separate_owners
checks.call_path: RobotRegistry.profile/runtime_adapter -> Push robot_binding(profile semantic base role, morphology and ABI) -> CellVariantDefinition/RobotTaskBinding -> compile_cell_manifest
checks.finding: Robot profile owns bodies/joints/morphology and adapter identifies asset/runtime. Push binding owns conversion from morphology to force/recovery protocol, task requirements and reward inputs. Shared harness sees the resolved cell and hashes. Morphology scaling is not reimplemented in generation/session.

checks.name: public_context_uses_task_projections_then_shared_receipt_boundary
checks.call_path: validated ledger/history -> task_memory_adapter.build_public_summary + task_prompt_adapter.build_prompt_sections -> sanitize_task_prompt_sections -> canonical task-section receipt -> public-only payload -> immutable prompt reference -> provider
checks.finding: Shared code validates allowed section names, public-safe structure, byte budget and payload identity; it does not interpret fall labels or force magnitude. Actual gen1/gen2 public-only checks and task receipts passed independently. Gen2 accepted-parent detailed failure omission is a task feedback sufficiency limitation already recorded, not a shared semantic leak.

supplementary_shared_token_check.role: Supplementary only; call paths and typed task interfaces above support the ownership conclusion.

limitations: The shared harness intentionally assumes two lanes and dev/accept/sealed phases. This is a research execution contract, not a claim to support arbitrary workflow topologies.
This run demonstrates one Go2 x Push cell. G1 and Stair matrix cells are not physically validated by A06, and full2x2 closure is not claimed.
Source-hash matches establish which local implementations were frozen; no whole-repository absence-of-coupling proof is claimed.
Go2 physics generalization and task-feedback completeness require their own evidence; no causal recovery improvement is inferred from structural boundary compliance.
